sentences.text: Petitioner/s  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Gudmala kumari, D/o- Umesh singh , Female, Aged about 23 years , R/o  village Barbariya Ward no- 24 , P.S. - Mehsaul Dist- Sitamarhi  ...

For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Rajiv Ranjan Singh  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Rabindra Kumar  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NAWNEET KUMAR  PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 5 23-12-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 31 of 2024,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 354(C)/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 66(C), 67(D) of the Information Technology (Amendment) Act 2000.
3. According to allegation, co-accused Raushan Kumar, on the pretext of marriage, sexually exploited the victim (the informant).
When Raushan Kumar became a constable, he refused to marry her.
The victim alleges that she had a number of photographs and videographs in support of her allegation.
In the last portion of the FIR, she levelled allegation against the Patna High Court CR.
MISC . No.45241 of 2025(5) dt.23-12-2025 petitioner, who is a friend of Raushan Kumar,
that he also blackmailed her on the basis of videographs and photographs transferred to him by Raushan Kumar.
4. The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the main allegation is against co-accused, Raushan Kumar.
The petitioner has falsely been implicated merely because he is a friend of Raushan Kumar.

He has further submitted that as a matter of fact, the informant herself Kunal Kumar @ Kunal Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 23 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144902140/
1 shared the photographs and videographs on her own sweet will with the petitioner on his ID, in order to pressurize his friend Raushan Kumar, for solemnization of marriage her.

entities.text: Kunal Kumar @ Kunal Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He has also submitted that the main accused Raushan Kumar is under custody.
The petitioner is a person of clean antecedent.
He has next submitted that none of the witnesses, examined by the I.O. has supported the occurrence against the petitioner.
5. On the other hand, the learned counsel for the informant has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the petitioner also sexually exploited the victim.
6. The witnesses examined during the investigation did not support the complicity of the petitioner.
He is a person of clean antecedent.

7. Considering the above-mentioned facts and Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.45241 of 2025(5)
dt.23-12-2025 circumstances, in the event of his arrest or surrender within four weeks before the learned court below, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned SDJM, Sadar,
Sitamarhi in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 31 of 2024, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the CrPC/482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) Nirmal/-
